# newreleases_matrix_rooms (Data Source)

Lists Matrix rooms connected to the account. Use their IDs in `newreleases_project.matrix_rooms`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "newreleases_matrix_rooms" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `rooms` (Attributes List) Connected Matrix rooms. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rooms))

<a id="nestedatt--rooms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rooms`

Read-Only:

- `homeserver_url` (String) Homeserver URL.
- `id` (String) Room ID.
- `internal_room_id` (String) Matrix room ID on the homeserver.
- `name` (String) Room name.
